about_the_game:
The art collection of "Puff Love Story" includes

1. Character Gallery

All different poses and expressions of the characters.

2. Event Gallery

All game event CGs, as well as unused images.

3. Background Gallery

All original background images used in the game.

4. Other Gallery

Various other images used in the game, including Q-version, promotional comics, and spoof images.

5. Production Remarks

Some creative insights during the game production process.

PDF format, you need to view the PDF format application to open it.

The file will be downloaded to the game installation directory. You can right-click the game name in the STEAM game list and select [Properties] - [Local Files] - [Browse] to open the game directory.
